reigns.note: Bastard son of Orestes who seized Lesbos and began the Aeolian migration to Asia Minor — ancestor of the colonists who settled the coast including Cyme.
Son of Echelas and grandson of Penthilus; led the Lacedaemonian and Achaean colonists who occupied the land between Ionia and Mysia called Aeolis, where Cyme stood as an Aeolian city.
